seo.title: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Columbus - No Home Help
seo.description: Current Columbus contacts for emergency shelter access, day services, food, health care, benefits, jobs and other help for people without stable housing.

page.heading: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Columbus
page.urgent: For immediate danger or a life-threatening medical emergency, call the local emergency number shown below.
page.notice: Shelters and services can be full, change hours or require an assessment or referral. Call before travelling whenever possible. No listing guarantees a bed, housing, treatment, benefits or a job.
page.intro: If one shelter is full, try the other local services and the referral lines below. Ask about day centres, outreach, food, hygiene, health care and the next safe option; do not rely on a single address.

entries.title: Community Shelter Board — homeless hotline
entries.description: Central route for shelter intake in Franklin County. Beds are not guaranteed; describe household, age, health, disability and safety needs and ask for every available alternative.

entries.title: 911 — emergency services
entries.description: Call for immediate danger, serious injury, overdose, fire or another life-threatening emergency. Give the exact location first.

entries.title: 211 — local shelter, food and health referrals
entries.description: Call 211 or use the directory for current local referrals. Ask the operator for more than one option because shelter capacity changes quickly.

entries.title: Faith Mission
entries.description: Emergency shelter and support; access is coordinated through the community hotline. Do not travel expecting direct admission unless staff confirm it.
entries.how_to_access: Call 614-274-7000 for current intake and capacity.

entries.title: Open Shelter
entries.description: Day services, meals, mail, hygiene and support for adults experiencing homelessness. It is not a guaranteed overnight bed, but can provide practical help and referrals.

entries.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
entries.description: Call or text 988 for mental-health or substance-use crisis support. Call 911 for immediate physical danger or a medical emergency.

entries.title: USA.gov benefit finder
entries.description: Official starting point for food, health, disability, housing and other public benefits. Eligibility and processing times vary.

entries.title: CareerOneStop — local job centres
entries.description: Official US Department of Labor directory for nearby American Job Centers, training and job search support.
